response.query: What item-level rubrics and performance anchors best operationalize professional skepticism/judgment quality for CAAT-enabled auditor tasks?
response.answer: Item-level rubrics for professional skepticism include questioning assumptions, verifying data, and challenging findings. Performance anchors are defined by thoroughness, critical analysis, and adherence to auditing standards. These ensure high-quality judgment in CAAT-enabled tasks.
